in_sanskrit.name: रामविलास
in_sanskrit.meaning: Rama's play, Rama's sport, Rama's joy

in_hindi.name: रामविलास
in_hindi.meaning: राम का विलास, राम का खेल, राम का अनन्द

in_tamil.name: ராமவிலாச்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ராமர் (Rāmar) அவ்விலாச் (avvilāṣ) - ராமர் கல்லிலையால் விழுந்தது (Rāmar kalillaiyāl vizuntathu) - ராமர் விலக்கியம் (Rāmar vilakkiam) - ராமர் விலக்கு (Rāmar vilakku)

in_telugu.name: Ramvilas
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ramvilas ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Ram Vilas means the abode of Lord Rama, who is considered as an ideal man and the embodiment of virtues, truth, and righteousness.

in_marathi.name: Ramvilas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramvilas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram Vilas means the abode of Lord Rama, who is considered as an ideal man and the embodiment of virtues, truth, and righteousness.

in_bengali.name: Ramvilas
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's Abode
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramvilas একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ram Vilas means the abode of Lord Rama, who is considered as an ideal man and the embodiment of virtues, truth, and righteousness.
